readme.key: Customer Value & Sustainability Review - Synthetic Builder-Ready Data Pack

readme.value: Structurally representative synthetic data for prototyping a multi-site customer value dashboard, sustainability review, AI insights and customer-ready report.
100% synthetic/illustrative. No row represents a real customer, wearer, asset, contract, laundry performance result or approved sustainability claim.
Annual customer review or steering-committee discussion: show value created, compare circular service with a selected baseline, identify site/product opportunities and recommend next actions.
NorthStar Foods Group: 24 delivery sites across Finland, Sweden and Poland, suitable for customer-level consolidation and site drill-down.
Outsourced local laundry. Home washing and in-house laundry are included as alternatives.
For prototype logic only: one completed repair postpones one replacement event. Results must be labelled estimated and sensitivity-tested.
Laundry-level waste is allocated to customer/site using the share of washed kilograms. This is an estimate, not directly measured customer waste.
customer_id, site_id, laundry_id, product_id, month and asset_id. See Data_Dictionary and Quick_Start.
Dashboard + customer-level/site drill-down + prompt-driven priority view + AI observations + PowerPoint/PDF export.
Do not present synthetic outputs as real Lindström/customer performance, audited figures or approved claims.
